verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Total Internal Reflection (TIR) and critical angle theta_c = arcsin(n_2/n_1) verified for n_1 > n_2. Evanescent wave decay and zero net time-averaged Poynting flux into medium 2 verified. Dimensional homogeneity confirmed: sin(theta_c) = n_2/n_1 is dimensionless; spatial decay constant kappa = (2*pi/lambda_0)*sqrt(n_1^2*sin^2(theta_1) - n_2^2) has units m^-1. Limiting cases verified: n_2 -> n_1 yields theta_c -> 90 degrees; n_2 -> 0 yields theta_c -> 0 degrees; theta_1 = theta_c yields grazing emergence theta_2 = 90 degrees. Assumptions audited: Optical boundary between lossless dielectric media, incident medium denser than refracting medium (n_1 > n_2), plane waves. Claim traces to curriculum node and formula-opt-critical-angle verified.
